title: Awesome Alhambra Experience!
text:
A totally awesome experience! My tour guide, Christina, was fantastic. She is a Granada native, and was able to share a complete history in an engaging way.  Her love of the Alhambra was obvious. I was the only solo traveler in my group, so stayed close to Christina and enjoyed her company and kindness. The beauty and magnitude of the Alhambra can't be imagined but must be experienced personally. 
A must visit if you are in Granada. And you will be extremely fortunate if Christina is your guide.
author: J5295HRamandag

title: Tour was cancelled. They gave a full refund and free ticket to enter!
text: The Alhambra ended up being closed temporarily during our tour time.  Crown tours refunded my money in full and still gave me a pass to go later in the day if it opened up. It did end up opening back up and I was able to go in and see everything later on my own time even though I got a full refund.
author: aslamkhaja

We visited the Alhambra on November 11, and Mar was our guide. She gave us a wonderful tour of the palace, sharing fascinating stories and interesting historical insights that really brought this magnificent place to life. She was knowledgeable, engaging, and passionate about the history of the Alhambra.
